about.meta_description: Think Positive Always offers practical inspiration for a stronger mindset, more confidence, and intentional personal growth. Learn what we stand for and who we serve.
about.title: Practical Inspiration for Real Life
about.intro: Practical inspiration for a stronger mindset, more confidence, and intentional personal growth.

story.heading: From daily encouragement to a home for growth
story.body: Think Positive Always began as a place for daily encouragement and has grown into a community of {community}, with audiences on other social platforms as well. This website is our new home: a place to go deeper than a single post and offer thoughtful articles and practical resources.
story.community_default: more than 280,000 people who follow Think Positive Always on LinkedIn
story.quote: We believe that thinking positively is not about pretending life is easy. It is about choosing a perspective that helps you keep going, and pairing that perspective with practical steps that make a real difference.

mission.default: Helping people develop a healthier mindset, navigate life's challenges, build confidence, and move forward through encouragement, thoughtful content, and useful personal development tools.

values.heading: For anyone ready to grow
values.description: Our readers are adults around the world who want to build a healthier mindset, strengthen their confidence, recover from setbacks, nurture better relationships, and live more intentionally. Some are navigating a difficult season. Others simply want to keep growing. All are welcome here.

items.title: Honest encouragement
items.text: We believe in hope that tells the truth. Our content acknowledges real challenges and meets people where they are.

items.title: Practical wisdom
items.text: Inspiration should be useful. We focus on ideas, tools, and small steps that people can apply in everyday life.

items.title: Growth at your own pace
items.text: Personal growth is not a race. We encourage progress over perfection and self-compassion over pressure.

items.title: Inclusive by design
items.text: Think Positive Always is for adults of every gender, background, and stage of life who want to grow with intention.

items.title: Written to encourage and educate
items.text: Our articles and resources are designed to encourage and educate.

items.title: Not a substitute for professional advice
items.text: Our content is not a substitute for professional medical, psychological, or financial advice. If you are struggling, please reach out to a qualified professional.

items.title: Partnerships clearly labelled
items.text: When content is sponsored or created in partnership with a brand, it will be clearly labelled. Sponsorship does not guarantee a positive review, and our editorial opinions remain our own.

community.heading: The people we write for
community.note: Each figure is a measurement taken on the date shown, not a live count. Social media followers are not website visitors.

closing.heading: Keep growing with us
closing.body: Explore our articles, or join The Positive Reset for a little encouragement every day.

urgent.heading: Need urgent support?
urgent.body: Think Positive Always is not a crisis or counselling service. If you are in immediate danger or need urgent emotional support, please contact your local emergency services or a licensed mental health professional. In the United States, you can call or text 988 to reach the 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline.

audience.heading: A community that values growth
paragraphs: Think Positive Always speaks to an international, primarily English-speaking audience, including readers across the United States. Our community is made up of adults of all genders who are interested in mindset, confidence, resilience, relationships, and intentional living.
They come to us for encouragement and practical perspective, which is why we only partner on messages we believe will be genuinely useful to them.

formats.description: Every collaboration is shaped around shared goals. These are some of the formats we can explore.

items.title: Transparent by default

alignment.heading: Partnerships built on shared values
alignment.description: Our readers' trust comes first. We look for partners whose work fits naturally with what Think Positive Always stands for.
items: Products, services, or causes that support well-being, growth, learning, or positive change.
A commitment to honest claims and respectful, inclusive messaging.
Respect for our audience: no misleading offers, pressure tactics, or harmful products.
Willingness to clearly disclose sponsored and affiliate relationships.
